For [filters](/docs/shell/commands/categories/filters/).

<div class='command-title'>Given a record, iterate on each pair of column name and associated value.</div>

## Command Type

`built-in`

## Signature

```> items {flags} (closure)```

## Parameters

 -  `closure`: The closure to run.


## Input/output types:

| input  | output |
| ------ | ------ |
| record | any    |
## Examples

Iterate over each key-value pair of a record
```nu
> { new: york, san: francisco } | items {|key, value| echo $'($key) ($value)' }
╭───┬───────────────╮
│ 0 │ new york      │
│ 1 │ san francisco │
╰───┴───────────────╯

```

## Notes
This is a fusion of `columns`, `values` and `each`.
